snippet.title: Opona - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game, coming soon to PC, Mac and Linux!

I hope you like this trailer, I've been working on Opona a lot and I'm excited to show off more stuff soon.

Opona has a Steam page now, please check it out and wishlist it if you can!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3747340/Opona/
There's also some fun new screenshots on there if you're into that sort of thing...

I've also updated the itch.io page:
https://rorycarson.itch.io/opona

You can also follow me on Bluesky at @rorycarson.bsky.social if you're interested in seeing more updates about Opona!

ok I think that's everything... I'll post more soon!
